items.negationCondition: Use-scoped representation is proven adequate, so substitution loses no relevant semantics.
A decisive claim remains reliable despite uncontrolled evaluator failures capable of changing standing.
An intended cross-scope claim transfers without relevant transfer evidence.
One fixed policy dominates materially different evidence/world conditions under same objective/budget.
No persistent-state responsibility exists or raw history is sufficient for the relevant use.
Lower-value higher-cost complexity should still be preferred under the same objective/horizon.
Future production-function effects never contribute to value.
Reliable realized counterevidence may leave model standing unchanged without epistemic defect.
Knowledge/capability automatically creates authority without a governing relation.
One scalar preserves all relevant distinctions despite demonstrated divergence and no aggregation rule.
A focal discovery alone always suffices and independent complements never matter.
Validation immediately entails durable service wherever realization stages are required.
Improved observability cannot expand/cheapen discriminable questions.
Shared standards/representations cannot coordinate independent producers/consumers.
Causal contribution is always concentrated in one actor/instant.
Where continuity is causally required, technical possibility becomes durable effect without it.
The most general/metaproductive route is always locally optimal across objectives/horizons.

result: Frozen S/R vocabulary mixes empirical regularities, guardrails, norms, axes and criteria; zero contradiction cannot imply universal confirmation.
